proposal.reason: Primary change is CI test orchestration/reporting: workflows now add generated datasets, 1/2/4/8-node and cross-rack execution routing, longer artifact retention, and a new performance workbook pipeline. The large `tests/xtest` additions (case-generation JSON families, grouping metadata, parser/report logic, and workflow contract tests) are supporting CI execution and result aggregation rather than PCCL runtime/module behavior changes.
